cases.title: Verify key requirements in Battery Life Under Typical Use
cases.objective: Check that the documented requirements for Battery Life Under Typical Use are represented correctly.
steps: Open the relevant device or application workflow.
Exercise the requirement described in the selected manual section.
Compare the observed behavior with the documented requirement.
cases.expected_result: Under typical use (three measurements per day), four AA alkaline batteries provide approximately 250 measurement cycles before requiring replacement — revised downward from earlier estimates after extended ﬁeld testing.
